news.lead: News pieces, interviews and reports about the project in national and institutional media.
news.feat.lead: The official presentation at the auditorium of the Facultad de Ciencias Físicas y Matemáticas of the Universidad de Chile kicked off the broadest coverage the project has had so far.
news.feat.card.p: The institutional article that gave rise to most of the coverage that followed. It gathers the project's figures at the time of the launch: more than 17,000 cumulative downloads before the formal presentation and a catalog of 76 models for Machine Learning and generative AI tasks, all of them running on the user's own computer.
news.feat.quote: “dashAI is proof that Chilean academia can develop artificial intelligence technology in an open and collaborative way, without depending on a single company, on private platforms or on foreign infrastructure.”
news.feat.quote.role: Dean of the Facultad de Ciencias Físicas y Matemáticas, Universidad de Chile
